name: Council of AI — commission_card
description: PAID (x402). Commission one signed card-v0 receipt (surface ras.commission) for a named subject on the frozen bank via https://councilof.ai/api/request-attestation. Re-serves every signed measurement card already on file for the subject; a payment never mints a MEASURED cell (fresh_run stays UNMEASURED until a published run exists). Without x_payment the tool returns the 402 challenge (accepts[] with asset, amount, payTo) plus a free preview of the cards already on file. Measurement, not certification — never a rank, a grade or a certificate. Verification stays free.
interface_note: commission_card is served by MCP tools/call at POST https://councilof.ai/mcp. It is not a skill of the A2A door at https://councilof.ai/api/a2a; that door's skills are the ones listed on https://councilof.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json. This card is generated by scripts/a2a-tool-cards.mjs from the manifests the door serves.

subject.description: Subject to commission: a model id, instrument id or card sha (1-120 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]).

axis.description: Optional axis slug; omit for the subject-level commission.

x_payment.description: The X-PAYMENT header value (base64 x402 payload) signed by your wallet against accepts[] from the previous 402. Omit to receive the challenge.
